text: give me a huge dam opportunity
ended: A huge dam opportunity does not fit on this map. "Huge" means a reservoir of at least about 1,520 blocks (four times the 380 blocks a drought needs near the start), and this 48-tile map's river valley is too small and shallow for that anywhere. The biggest dam site I can make holds about 309 blocks: a 6-tile dam, 3 high, on the main river in the centre. That is still less than one drought's need. The dam site already on the map holds 178. Say "yes" and I'll add the 309-block site, or try a bigger map.
